cohort: The study cohort consisted of 57 maternal deaths that occurred in a tertiary hospital in South Africa between March 2018 and February 2022.
finding: The institutional maternal mortality ratio was lower during the COVID-19 pandemic than before, with a significant difference in primary causes of death (preeclampsia before, COVID-19 during), and avoidable factors related to healthcare professionals were the most common in both periods.
cross-section timing: March 2018 - February 2020 (before COVID-19) and March 2020 - February 2022 (during COVID-19)
